title: Why Sign Shops Must Stop Designing for Free
description: Many sign shops still give design away for free, and it's damaging the entire industry. Joe and Liz discuss the true value of design work and how to charge what you're worth.
keyTakeaways: Free design devalues the entire industry and your expertise
Clients who won't pay for design often become problem customers
Separate design fees from production to show true value
Educate clients on the design process and time investment
Build design costs into your pricing if you won't charge separately
